about: Tokens we add on top of design-tokens.json. The Stitch export stays unchanged; scripts/generate-theme.mjs merges this file into it and refuses a token that already exists there.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text inside inputs. 4.55:1 on surfaceContainerLowest (the input fill), where text.tertiary is only 3.32:1. text.tertiary stays for inactive icons.

content.description: The widest the app's column gets. Phones are narrower, so nothing changes there; on a tablet or a browser window the app sits in a centered column of this width instead of stretching (ADR-050).

brandTitle.description: The app's name in the brand header: h1's size with hero's weight and spacing, drawn with the brand gradient (ADR-051).
